name: Professional Services — Personal Blog
definition: Writing, essays, newsletters, and personal publishing sites

business_name.label: Blog or author name
business_name.followUp: What name should appear on your blog? For example, "The Desk" or "Alex Chen".

services.label: Topics or themes
services.followUp: What do you write about? List a few topics or themes — for example, "productivity", "essays", or "frontend development".

tagline.label: Tagline
tagline.followUp: What's a one-line tagline or description for your blog? For example, "Notes on building software with care".

tone_preference.label: Writing tone
tone_preference.followUp: What writing tone fits your blog best? Reply with thoughtful, casual, technical, witty, or personal.

theme_mode_preference.label: Theme mode
theme_mode_preference.followUp: Should your blog default to dark mode, light mode, or include a dark/light toggle?

cta_preference.label: Subscribe CTA
cta_preference.followUp: How should readers subscribe or get in touch? Reply with newsletter signup, email link, or contact form.

city.label: Location
city.followUp: Do you want to mention a city or location on your blog? (Optional — reply skip to leave blank)

newsletter_cta.label: Newsletter button text
newsletter_cta.followUp: What should the subscribe button say? For example, "Join the newsletter" or "Get new posts by email". (Optional — reply skip to use a default)

email.label: Email address
email.followUp: What email should readers use to reach you or subscribe?

x_account.label: X account
x_account.followUp: What's your X (Twitter) handle? (optional — reply skip to leave blank)

linkedin_id.label: LinkedIn profile
linkedin_id.followUp: What's your LinkedIn profile ID or username? (optional — reply skip to leave blank)
